credit_ledger_amount_check.name: credit_ledger_amount_check
credit_ledger_amount_check.value:
"credit_ledger"."credits" <> 0 and (
    ("credit_ledger"."entry_type" in ('grant', 'purchase', 'subscription', 'refund') and "credit_ledger"."credits" > 0)
    or ("credit_ledger"."entry_type" in ('consumption', 'expiration') and "credit_ledger"."credits" < 0)
    or "credit_ledger"."entry_type" = 'adjustment')

credit_ledger_manual_reference_check.name: credit_ledger_manual_reference_check
credit_ledger_manual_reference_check.value: "credit_ledger"."entry_type" not in ('grant', 'adjustment', 'refund', 'expiration') or ("credit_ledger"."reference" is not null and btrim("credit_ledger"."reference") <> '')

credit_ledger_origin_check.name: credit_ledger_origin_check
credit_ledger_origin_check.value: ("credit_ledger"."bucket" is null or "credit_ledger"."bucket" in ('included', 'rollover', 'extra')) and ("credit_ledger"."credits" > 0 or "credit_ledger"."bucket" is null) and ("credit_ledger"."credits" < 0 or "credit_ledger"."breakdown" is null)
